offer.text: These old bones don't like the dark anymore. Would you walk beside me to my own bed? I'll lead — just see that nothing troubles us on the way.

accept.text: You're a comfort. Let's go slow and steady.

decline.text: Ah well. I'll sit by the lamp a while longer.

ready.text: My own door at last. What a relief.

complete.text: Tucked in safe, and all thanks to you. Sleep well, friend.

failed.text: Such a fright we had... I'll not venture out after dark again soon.
